attchmntText: MphasiS Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Mphasis Limited filed a transcript of its Q2 FY2027 earnings conference call held on November 6, 2026, pursuant to SEBI Regulation 30. The company reported net new total contract value of $466 million for the quarter. CEO Nitin Rakesh stated the firm achieved its strongest sequential growth in three years and raised its annual growth guidance. AI-led deals now constitute 71% of the pipeline. Direct business revenue grew 3.5% sequentially and 11.3% year-over-year in constant currency. The Americas remained the primary growth engine. EBIT margin remained flat. Earnings per share increased 14.6% sequentially to INR 29.4. Operating cash flow was USD 34 million. Days sales outstanding stood at 105 days. The transcript is available on the company website.

attchmntText: MphasiS Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Allotment of 152891  Shares.
voiceSummary: Mphasis Limited intimates that its ESOP Compensation Committee approved the allotment of 1,52,891 equity shares on 8 November 2026. This allotment is against the exercise of Employee Stock Options and Restricted Stock Units. Specifically, 15,500 shares were allotted under the Employee Stock Options Plan 2016. Additionally, 1,37,391 shares were allotted under the Restricted Stock Units Plan 2021. For employees exercising options under the Cashless Scheme, the Mphasis Employees Equity Reward Trust will deduct shares to cover exercise prices and taxes. These proceeds will repay loans from the company. Similarly, the Mphasis Employees Benefit Trust will deduct shares for the RSU Plan 2021 to cover costs and taxes. The terms of exercise follow the respective plans already submitted to stock exchanges.

attchmntText: MphasiS Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Mphasis Limited submitted newspaper publications regarding its audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on November 5, 2026. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 6,946.02 million, with profit after tax at 5,137.07 million. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, revenue was 13,156.69 million, and profit after tax was 9,729.20 million. The company acquired stakes in Aokah Inc., Locate Software Inc., OKIN Process Inc., and Theory and Practice Business Intelligence Inc. A definitive agreement to acquire a customer contract from RedOak Tech, Inc. for up to 2,650.55 million remains uncompleted. Subsequent to the balance sheet date, the Group received a Canada Revenue Agency demand notice for CAD 6.60 million. Separately, the National Stock Exchange delisted equity shares of Poddar Housing and Development Limited effective October 16, 2026, due to non-compliances.
